judge_input.description:
## Problem

`@effect/opentelemetry` marks `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node` and `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web` optional peers, yet exports both from `index.ts` as static ESM imports, so resolution fails when they aren't installed:

```
Error: Cannot find package '@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web' imported from 
.../@effect/opentelemetry/dist/esm/WebSdk.js
```

## Solution

Make both required peers by removing them from `peerDependenciesMeta`.

## Changes

- Removed `optional: true` for `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node` and `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web`

## Testing

- Build passes
- All tests pass (15/15)
